Crypt of the Drowned Kings.atmosphere: Brine and old incense cling to the air here; the dead were buried facing the sea.
dark: a cold, wet blackness that sloshes like deep water
details: a mosaic of a drowned city

The Fungal Undergrowth.atmosphere: The air is thick and sweet with spores; something is always growing here.
floors: leaf-litter of grey caps and spore-dust
dark: a blackness that smells of loam and rot

Hall of Broken Bells.atmosphere: Bronze and silence. The bells here are shattered in their frames; whatever they rang for is over.
walls: walls hung with cracked bronze plaques
floors: scattered fragments of clappers and chains
dark: a darkness that seems to hold its breath
details: a fallen bell half-buried in rubble
a choir stall rotted to lace
engraved dedications in a dead tongue

The Salt Quarries.atmosphere: Everything here is mined: white walls, white dust, a dryness that drinks the spit from your mouth.
walls: sheer cut walls of pink salt
details: a collapsed stair cut into the salt

Cinder Warrens.atmosphere: Ash drifts down from somewhere above, and the stone holds a sullen, banked heat.
floors: a crust of ash over hot stone
dark: a darkness that radiates heat like a closed oven
details: melted coins fused to the floor
a scorch mark in the shape of a doorway

The Ossuary.atmosphere: Bone is the local building material here, and it has been arranged with care.
light: pale light through rose-window of vertebrae
dark: a darkness like the inside of a closed coffin
details: an ossuary cross of crossed ribs
shins set like book-spines in niches

The Drowned Armory.atmosphere: Water took this place by inches. Rusted steel stands at attention in the dark.
walls: walls hung with rusted mail and shields
floors: wet stone strewn with buckled scabbards
light: light glinting off a hundred rusty blades
dark: a darkness that laps quietly at your boots
details: a rack of spears fused to rust
a toppled banner stock in the water

Library of Stone.atmosphere: Every surface is carved with text. The library was cut from the living rock and never closed.
floors: worn stone steps polished by readers
light: light tuned to a scholar's glare
dark: a darkness like an unread page
